description: This file defines the 'PendingTimesheetSummary' class within the OrangeHRM project. The class is part of the Dashboard ActionSummary DTOs for handling pending timesheet approvals. It encapsulates logic to filter and count employee timesheets awaiting approval or rejection, based on user roles and workflow states.

classes.name: PendingTimesheetSummary
classes.description: A DTO class representing a summary for pending timesheets that require approval. It initializes filters based on accessible employee numbers, retrieves actionable workflow states, and provides methods to get group information and count of pending timesheets.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PendingTimesheetSummary instance with filters for accessible employee numbers and actionable workflow states for approval or rejection.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID associated with this summary, which is statically set to 2.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the group, 'Timesheets To Approve'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee timesheets pending approval, based on the current filters.
